mcqs.keyword: New logo and number of zones
mcqs.question: Following the formation of South Coast Railway as the 18th zone, how many stars were featured in the new Indian Railways logo, with one star representing each zone?
mcqs.explanation: The new Indian Railways logo features 18 stars, with one star for each zone. The figures 99.6%, 741 crore and 1,670 MT refer respectively to Broad Gauge electrification, passengers and record freight, not to the number of stars in the logo.
